summary.text: William Muto is the Democratic candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the September 9, 2026 Democratic primary, and Ballotpedia lists Clean Water Action and Planned Parenthood Votes! Rhode Island among his endorsers.
